markers.to: I ↔ II; eastern road to the graveyard
II ↔ III; approach to the gate opened by Weegli Blastfuse
II ↔ IV; western road from the pyramid area to the pool
IV ↔ I; southern return to the entrance plaza

uncertain: Zerillis, Dustwraith and Sandarr Dunereaver are rare; dashed markers indicate approximate search areas, not verified spawn coordinates.
Hydromancer Velratha patrols around the pool; marker 11 is approximate.
The exact position of the Tablet of Theka within Theka’s area is unverified.
notes: Numbering follows an eastern-first circuit with optional rare encounters. Bosses 6 and 7 fight together, as do 9 and 10.
Free the prisoners after defeating the Sandfury Executioner on the pyramid. The executioner is an event guard, not a separately numbered boss.
Sergeant Bly begins on the summit; marker 8 shows the initial location, not his later fight position. Ask Weegli Blastfuse to open the gate before provoking Bly.
Q2 drops from Theka, Q3 from Nekrum, Q4 from Bly, Q5 and Q6 from Velratha, and Q7 from Gahz'rilla. Quest labels use leader lines where needed.
The gong requires the Mallet of Zul'Farrak in Vanilla.
Troll Temper and Scarab Shells are distributed drops; scarabs occur around Theka.
Courtyard outlines are simplified; minor ruins and graves are omitted.
